_comment: Declarative spec for the `reciterai` DynamoDB table (#223 IaC, single-file convention per infra/README.md D-10). This file is BOTH the rebuild spec and the documented durability invariant. KeySchema / AttributeDefinitions / GlobalSecondaryIndexes / BillingMode are byte-faithful to utils/dynamodb_helpers.py create_chatbot_table (enforced by tests/test_infra_dynamodb_table_parity.py, so they cannot silently drift). DeletionProtectionEnabled + Tags are the durability hardening the bare creator historically omitted; DeletionProtectionEnabled is now also set inline in create_chatbot_table. PITR is NOT a CreateTable attribute -- see _pitr and scripts/apply_backup_config.sh.

_pitr.note: PITR is not a CreateTable attribute. scripts/apply_backup_config.sh enables it via `update-continuous-backups` after the table is ACTIVE. A PITR-restored table comes back with PITR OFF -- re-run apply_backup_config.sh post-restore (docs/dr-runbook.md, Scenario A step A5).
